name: Least Minor and Flawed Magic Rings
body:
Creating Least Minor and Flawed Magic Rings

Lesser and Flawed magic rings make use of cantrips, and low level spells or provides notably scaled down version of more powerful iconic rings. As a result, quite a few of them may not perfectly fit the standard pricing structure for pricing magical items, however, care has been taken to provide balanced options, both in regard to power level and character wealth at lower levels.

The Ring Apprentice feat presents a modified structure for calculating crafting costs and times when creating lower level magic rings.
